beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It leaves room for commercial services around shared foundations.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The choice is not automatically between one private monopoly and one public monopoly.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers encounter design questions that disappear when every project becomes another startup pitch.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The argument becomes more demanding when a barrier protects something people legitimately value.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Privacy, due process, and the right to refuse optimization can slow useful systems.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Technical superiority does not settle whose risks or freedoms should be traded away.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book also examines coordinated restraint, concentrated losses, and competition for status.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These cases prevent its map from becoming a demand to build every feasible invention.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A proposed change must preserve the values that made the original project worthwhile.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That makes political judgment part of the method, rather than an obstacle outside it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The final chapters examine how institutions make unresolved conflicts sound comfortably coherent.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The author uses smoothing for compression that removes something essential to a decision.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A proposal may erase affected people or delayed costs without containing an obvious falsehood.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: AI can repeat this pattern by producing fluent accounts of an unchanged contradiction.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The alternative is to preserve the relation that makes the decision difficult.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book’s diagnostic names are working tools, not established universal laws.
